theme_strategy.theme_rationale: VeriTrust AI operates at the intersection of enterprise AI, insurance policy simplification, and Polygon-style blockchain cryptographic verification. A deep obsidian dark surface with vivid cyber emerald (#10B981) and cobalt sapphire (#2563EB / #3B82F6) accents immediately communicates institutional security, high-tech intelligence, and immutable ledger trust without visual fatigue.

rules: NO Inter or generic sans for hero and section headings; use Outfit / Cabinet Grotesk with bold weighting
All hash strings, smart contract addresses, CID IPFS, SHA-256 tokens MUST use font-mono (JetBrains Mono) with letter-spacing-wide
Maximum heading cap is text-6xl (no text-8xl or text-9xl)
Maintain tight tracking on all sizes above 28px

routes.name: LandingPage

routes.name: Dashboard
routes.description: Command center: policy counts, verified status, risk radar/breakdown, recent uploads, action triggers

routes.name: PolicyAnalysis

routes.name: PolicyHistory
routes.description: Filterable/searchable inventory of user policies with status, risk score, date, and blockchain verification badge

routes.name: PolicyCompare

routes.name: AskAI
routes.description: Interactive policy chat assistant with suggested prompts ('Does my policy cover robotic surgery?', 'What is my pre-existing disease waiting clause?'), multi-language answers, and citation references

routes.name: VerificationCenter

routes.name: UserProfile

voice_player.description: Audio summary player with animated waveform bars (CSS keyframes), speed toggle (1x, 1.25x, 1.5x), and play/pause controls in English, Hindi, and Marathi.
voice_player.implementation: Uses Web Speech Synthesis API (window.speechSynthesis) with graceful simulated waveform audio fallback so any user can immediately listen to their policy in simple human words.

risk_gauge_widget.description: SVG Circular Arc or Recharts Radial gauge showing 0-100 score, dynamic color shifting (Green <35, Amber 36-69, Red 70+), accompanied by a 'Why this score?' breakdown list of deductions/bonuses.
risk_gauge_widget.implementation: SVG conic-gradient or SVG stroke-dashoffset animation with Framer Motion count-up.

blockchain_transaction_pulse.description: Polygon block pill showing live block confirmation count, hash truncation with instant 1-click clipboard copy, and visual IPFS pin confirmation icon.
blockchain_transaction_pulse.implementation: Interactive copy-to-clipboard with Sonner toast feedback and cryptographic block explorer modal.

multi_language_toggle.scope: Seamlessly translates policy summaries, simplified clauses, and voice narration.

anti_ai_slop_rules: Never create generic light-gray cards with centered text and zero texture. Every card must have a crisp 1px subtle border, deep obsidian tint, and clear visual hierarchy.
Do NOT use pure #000000 for backgrounds; use #070B14 tinted with navy/slate so elements retain spatial depth.
No full-screen gradients. Use directional 1px border glows and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0c1427]/80).
Never center-align the main application container or paragraphs. Keep left alignment for human reading rhythm.
Every interactive button, tab, and card must provide explicit hover and focus states with contrast-compliant text.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing_attribute_requirement: Every clickable button, link, tab, filter, and input must include data-testid with kebab-case conventions exactly as cataloged in data_testid_manifest.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.mock_and_integration_notes: If live Polygon RPC or IPFS infura keys are unconfigured, HIGHLIGHT that blockchain hashes are GENERATED CRYPTOGRAPHICALLY (SHA-256 + simulated Polygon Mumbai/Amoy contract state) with real hash verification fidelity, so the user experiences authentic Web3 verification workflows without gas friction.
